mine_floor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one SEAMLESS TILEABLE game terrain ALBEDO TEXTURE, a square image, designed on a 256x256 HARD-EDGE PIXEL ART grid. Paint the material itself edge-to-edge; NO image border, no margin, no tile outline, no perspective slab, no transparency. This is a flat material map, not a lit scene.
CRITICAL: EXACT FOUR-WAY SEAMLESS tiling, left edge continues perfectly into right edge, top edge continues perfectly into bottom edge. Treat canvas as a torus: any shape hitting an edge must wrap to the opposite edge with matching color and continuity. Even distribution throughout, no central focal point, no distinctive symbol, no vignette, no outer stripe. Repeating 3x3 must look like one continuous material field with no grid.
UNLIT INTRINSIC MATERIAL COLOR ONLY: NO directional illumination, NO cast shadows, NO shiny highlights, NO specular, NO ambient occlusion shading around stones, NO raised 3D edges. Only narrow dark natural cracks/crevices are allowed. No gradients or blurred transitions, no soft brush, no antialiasing. Use crisp irregular PIXEL CLUSTERS, large and medium and small clusters nested naturally, not a regular checkerboard or artificial repeated noise pattern. Hand-painted art direction rather than algorithmic noise. Do not draw objects, plants, footprints or writing unless specified. MATERIAL mine_floor: Flat top-down COMPACTED EARTH and small broken gravel, neutral fairly uniform traversable mining-tunnel ground. About 70% packed brown earth with small irregular scattered 2-8 native-pixel chips, small crack marks, no road lanes or wear tracks because those are overlaid by the game. Overall DARKER medium brown, not nearly black, muted earth and stone colors. Low contrast and balanced uniform distribution, no distinctive large boulder, no footprints, no central focal mark.
SCALE: this tile covers 5x5 meters; human height is 1.6m. Respect the described feature scale.
PALETTE: use ONLY these 8 sRGB hexadecimal colors (and ensure all 8 appear as natural material-color variation, not swatches): #2c251d, #3b3127, #4a3e30, #5e4f3c, #6e5d48, #8a7a63, #615646, #988164. Solid color clusters only, NO dithering gradients. Return one continuous square seamless texture, not a 3x3 preview and not a swatch sheet.
